purpose: Freeze the serving and asset-reload journeys used by IO Watch v1 P1 before qualification.

common_semantics.lifetime: one watcher and one event owner remain established outside timing; every charged publication is awaited and classified before the next episode
common_semantics.freshness: the consumer re-reads an eight-byte authoritative generation so duplicate/coalesced notifications cannot satisfy a later publication
common_semantics.progress: both routes use their natural persistent asynchronous owner and native file-event backend; neither polls, creates a thread per event or registers a per-event timer
common_semantics.accounting: the same HYLE Platform FS helper publishes and re-reads each generation for both routes, so only watcher routing, dispatch, batching and lifecycle differ

workloads.consumer: an inference service observes one TLS/config/model sidecar while an editor atomically replaces it
workloads.target: one exact file observed through its existing parent directory
workloads.episode: write and close one sibling replacement, atomically publish it, receive a matching change and re-read the exact generation

workloads.consumer: a renderer or model-shard cache invalidates one flat asset directory after a bounded publication burst
workloads.target: one non-recursive directory containing eight stable direct children
workloads.episode: rewrite all eight child generations, receive/coalesce direct-child changes, classify all eight names and re-read every authoritative generation

negative_space: watcher/runtime construction and one warmup episode per route are outside timing
deadline and cancellation races are correctness/lifecycle gates, not charged to only one side of this successful-event comparison
recursive traversal, debounce, content parsing and application reload policy are not watcher work
a raw inotify, IOCP or FSEvents syscall is not an admissible peer for the complete owner-to-consumer route
callback count is not treated as an event-log guarantee; the gate observes authoritative publications
